description.content:
Read-only REST/JSON API for Django CMS that enables decoupled frontend applications to consume CMS-managed content. Built on Django REST Framework with OpenAPI 3 schema generation via drf-spectacular. Supports multi-language, multi-site, draft/preview access, and is compatible with Redis/Memcached caching.
